learning_outcomes.text: Students will be able to use the methods and techniques of extreme programming methodology: pair programming, defining and use of unit tests, test driven programming, clean code, refactoring, code review, working with legacy code.
Students will be able to use Chat GPT in programming: advantages and drawbacks.
They will be able to organize work according to the methodology of extreme programming.

syllabus_topics: Pillars of extreme programming (XP): pairwise programming
Typology of tests and their use
Principles of project management in XP
ChatGPT in programming: advantages and drawbacks

assessment_methods.method: Continuous evaluation: exercises, presentations, homework assignments

assessment_rules: The final grade is based on continuous evaluation (50%), a final exam (30%), and a final essay (20%). A 90%, B 80%, C 70%, D 60%, E 50%. The scale of assessment is 50/50 for preliminary/final.
